<span id="vorago" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
= <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><nowiki>Vorago</nowiki></span> =
<div class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed pvme-export-media-meta" style="margin:0.8em 0;padding:0.6em 0.8em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;max-width:100%;"><strong>Contents</strong><div class="mw-collapsible-content" style="max-height:24em;overflow:auto;">

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/sY7JVkg9No.png</span></p>
<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="introduction" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Vorago is a high level group boss. He boasts high defence and complex mechanics that challenge even the best players. His unique drops include Tectonic Energies and Seismic equipment.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>This guide is only an introduction + mechanics guide. For a beginner guide ‎ ‎use </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span><nowiki>, for DPS rotations, see </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-left:5px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.08);">
<span id="presets-general" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Presets - General</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="general-notes" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>General Notes</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ New players </nowiki><em><nowiki>must</nowiki></em><nowiki> talk to Vorago and go through his dialogue options first before they can enter the fight.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Select &quot;What are you doing here?&quot;, followed by &quot;Can I face you?&quot;</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Once players reach the &quot;So, do we fight?&quot; dialogue, they are eligible to fight Vorago.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The default familiar is </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="bloodnihil">[[File:Blood nihil pouch.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475442169053194.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>bloodnihil</nowiki>|<nowiki>bloodnihil</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="shadownihil">[[File:Shadow nihil.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475441946230855.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>shadownihil</nowiki>|<nowiki>shadownihil</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="smokenihil">[[File:Smoke nihil.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475442227642388.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>smokenihil</nowiki>|<nowiki>smokenihil</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> for all combat styles.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• A Beast of Burden can be used, but is highly discouraged due to Vorago's massive defensive stats.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vorago is immune to familiar damage.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="vulnbomb">[[File:Vulnerability bomb.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>vulnbomb</nowiki>|<nowiki>vulnbomb</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> are primarily used only once, during phase 5. They can also be spammed during damage-based phases.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="picking-a-combat-style" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Picking A Combat Style</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>All three combat styles are viable at Vorago.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Ranged and Melee are the strongest styles.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Magic is not far behind, and performs similarly to Ranged if Ranged does not have its expensive best-in-slot gear.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Melee can be difficult to use. Its range limitation applies several restrictions.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Not recommended for beginners</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Melee distance can cause less experienced players to take more damage</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Unable to Bomb Tank in conventional teams</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="preset-notes" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Preset Notes</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ A 1-dose </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="powerburstofvitality">[[File:Powerburst of vitality (4).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>powerburstofvitality</nowiki>|<nowiki>powerburstofvitality</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> can be used on most weeks for entry damage alone.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Multiple doses are required for Green Bomb, and highly recommended for Ceiling Collapse, Teamsplit, and The End.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dummy">[[File:Combat dummy MKII.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dummy</nowiki>|<nowiki>dummy</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> can be used to build adrenaline between phases for more damage.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Optional</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Often used with </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="nat">[[File:Natural Instinct.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>nat</nowiki>|<nowiki>nat</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ A </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="greatgunkan">[[File:Great gunkan.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689528927928188963.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>greatgunkan</nowiki>|<nowiki>greatgunkan</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> is eaten after taking entry damage to free up an inventory space for equipping 2H weapons.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="berserker">[[File:Berserker aura.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505116347105290.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>berserker</nowiki>|<nowiki>berserker</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="mani">[[File:Maniacal aura.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505153709965322.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>mani</nowiki>|<nowiki>mani</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="reckless">[[File:Reckless aura.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505179378974748.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>reckless</nowiki>|<nowiki>reckless</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> are highly recommended due to Vorago's high defensive parameters.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Other auras are discouraged, though supreme accuracy auras can be used.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Putting Turtling 3 over Turtling 4 </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="turt4">[[File:Turtling.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073737377284146.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>turt4</nowiki>|<nowiki>turt4</nowiki>]]<span class="pvme-export-media-meta pvme-export-rank" style="position:absolute;bottom:0;right:0;min-width:0.8em;padding:0 0.1em;border:1px solid #111;border-radius:2px;background-color:#fff;color:#111;font-size:0.65em;font-weight:700;line-height:1.1;text-align:center;">4</span></span><nowiki> on your t90 shield is recommended.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The extra tick of Barricade </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> from </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="turt4">[[File:Turtling.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073737377284146.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>turt4</nowiki>|<nowiki>turt4</nowiki>]]<span class="pvme-export-media-meta pvme-export-rank" style="position:absolute;bottom:0;right:0;min-width:0.8em;padding:0 0.1em;border:1px solid #111;border-radius:2px;background-color:#fff;color:#111;font-size:0.65em;font-weight:700;line-height:1.1;text-align:center;">4</span></span><nowiki> is irrelevant, and it can cause issues primarily with </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> cooldown on The End P4 if mistimed.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="rune-pouch-setup" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Rune Pouch Setup</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="blackpouch">[[File:Large rune pouch (black).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656786565359599626.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>blackpouch</nowiki>|<nowiki>blackpouch</nowiki>]]</span> <strong><nowiki>Rune Pouch</nowiki></strong> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Airrune">[[File:Air rune.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252658986647589.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Airrune</nowiki>|<nowiki>Airrune</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Deathrune">[[File:Death rune.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252659586433024.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Deathrune</nowiki>|<nowiki>Deathrune</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Earthrune">[[File:Earth rune.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252659808731137.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Earthrune</nowiki>|<nowiki>Earthrune</nowiki>]]</span></p>

</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="basic-melee-preset" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Basic Melee Preset</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sgb">[[File:Seren godbow.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sgb</nowiki>|<nowiki>sgb</nowiki>]]</span> <strong><nowiki>Seren Godbow</nowiki></strong><nowiki> is used with </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="ingen">[[File:Ingenuity of the Humans.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339234111848463.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>ingen</nowiki>|<nowiki>ingen</nowiki>]]</span> <strong><nowiki>Ingenuity of the Humans</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This is optional and can be omitted.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="swh">[[File:Superior Statius's warhammer.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>swh</nowiki>|<nowiki>swh</nowiki>]]</span> <strong><nowiki>Superior Statius Warhammer</nowiki></strong><nowiki> is an integral part of melee.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• While it is optional, it is heavily recommended.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="aosor">[[File:Amulet of souls (or).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544200033847869443.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>aosor</nowiki>|<nowiki>aosor</nowiki>]]</span> <strong><nowiki>Amulet of Souls</nowiki></strong><nowiki> is a suitable alternative to </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="reaperor">[[File:Reaper necklace (or).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544200033390690335.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>reaperor</nowiki>|<nowiki>reaperor</nowiki>]]</span> <strong><nowiki>Reaper Necklace</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="VampScrim">[[File:Scrimshaw of vampyrism.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201294262009874.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>VampScrim</nowiki>|<nowiki>VampScrim</nowiki>]]</span> <strong><nowiki>Vampyrism Scrimshaw</nowiki></strong><nowiki> can be used on time gated phases to preserve food. </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="SaraBook">[[File:Saradomin's Book of Wisdom.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/574290439482638346.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>SaraBook</nowiki>|<nowiki>SaraBook</nowiki>]]</span> <strong><nowiki>Saradomin Book</nowiki></strong><nowiki> should be used for damage-based phases.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="SaraBook">[[File:Saradomin's Book of Wisdom.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/574290439482638346.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>SaraBook</nowiki>|<nowiki>SaraBook</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> has a cooldown upon activation, and should be activated at face, the end of phase 2, and the end of p4.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/KnqLp9P.png</span></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="advanced-melee-preset" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Advanced Melee Preset</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="drygorelongoh">[[File:Off-hand drygore longsword.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/852939843767369783.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>drygorelongoh</nowiki>|<nowiki>drygorelongoh</nowiki>]]</span> <strong><nowiki>off-hand Drygore</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>Flanking 4</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎</nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="flank4">[[File:Flanking.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088296157185.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>flank4</nowiki>|<nowiki>flank4</nowiki>]]<span class="pvme-export-media-meta pvme-export-rank" style="position:absolute;bottom:0;right:0;min-width:0.8em;padding:0 0.1em;border:1px solid #111;border-radius:2px;background-color:#fff;color:#111;font-size:0.65em;font-weight:700;line-height:1.1;text-align:center;">4</span></span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="eofblacku">[[File:Essence of Finality amulet (black).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1260022289731158146.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>eofblacku</nowiki>|<nowiki>eofblacku</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> with Statius Warhammer </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="swh">[[File:Superior Statius's warhammer.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>swh</nowiki>|<nowiki>swh</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="eofred">[[File:Essence of Finality amulet (or)(red).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/780401412839833601.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>eofred</nowiki>|<nowiki>eofred</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> with Dragon Claws </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dragonclaw">[[File:Dragon claw.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/779048041088024606.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dragonclaw</nowiki>|<nowiki>dragonclaw</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="eof">[[File:Essence of Finality amulet.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787526151978614824.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>eof</nowiki>|<nowiki>eof</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> with Dragon Halberd </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dragonhalberd">[[File:Dragon halberd.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409589261238282.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dragonhalberd</nowiki>|<nowiki>dragonhalberd</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dbow">[[File:Dark bow.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dbow</nowiki>|<nowiki>dbow</nowiki>]]</span> <strong><nowiki>Darkbow</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>Invigorating 4</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎</nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="invig4">[[File:Invigorating.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087859949570.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>invig4</nowiki>|<nowiki>invig4</nowiki>]]<span class="pvme-export-media-meta pvme-export-rank" style="position:absolute;bottom:0;right:0;min-width:0.8em;padding:0 0.1em;border:1px solid #111;border-radius:2px;background-color:#fff;color:#111;font-size:0.65em;font-weight:700;line-height:1.1;text-align:center;">4</span></span><nowiki> + </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>Aftershock 1</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎</nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="as1">[[File:Aftershock.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502339891331093.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>as1</nowiki>|<nowiki>as1</nowiki>]]<span class="pvme-export-media-meta pvme-export-rank" style="position:absolute;bottom:0;right:0;min-width:0.8em;padding:0 0.1em;border:1px solid #111;border-radius:2px;background-color:#fff;color:#111;font-size:0.65em;font-weight:700;line-height:1.1;text-align:center;">1</span></span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Used for building adrenaline on </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dummy">[[File:Combat dummy MKII.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dummy</nowiki>|<nowiki>dummy</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="glaivemh">[[File:Shadow glaive.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643161561988595782.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>glaivemh</nowiki>|<nowiki>glaivemh</nowiki>]]</span> <strong><nowiki>Shadow Glaive</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>Energising 4</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎</nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="energising4">[[File:Energising.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/851514466818457640.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>energising4</nowiki>|<nowiki>energising4</nowiki>]]<span class="pvme-export-media-meta pvme-export-rank" style="position:absolute;bottom:0;right:0;min-width:0.8em;padding:0 0.1em;border:1px solid #111;border-radius:2px;background-color:#fff;color:#111;font-size:0.65em;font-weight:700;line-height:1.1;text-align:center;">4</span></span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Used for building adrenaline on </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dummy">[[File:Combat dummy MKII.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dummy</nowiki>|<nowiki>dummy</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="blackstonearrow">[[File:Black stone arrows 4.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/785031580149743617.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>blackstonearrow</nowiki>|<nowiki>blackstonearrow</nowiki>]]</span> <strong><nowiki>Black Stone Arrows</nowiki></strong><nowiki> are used to add a </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="blackstonearrow">[[File:Black stone arrows 4.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/785031580149743617.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>blackstonearrow</nowiki>|<nowiki>blackstonearrow</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> stack with </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sgb">[[File:Seren godbow.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sgb</nowiki>|<nowiki>sgb</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="spec">[[File:Weapon Special Attack.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>spec</nowiki>|<nowiki>spec</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="zgs">[[File:Zaros godsword.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626465964325601290.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>zgs</nowiki>|<nowiki>zgs</nowiki>]]</span> <strong><nowiki>Zaros Godsword</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="spec">[[File:Weapon Special Attack.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>spec</nowiki>|<nowiki>spec</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> is situationally used and can be omitted.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/FkhsEFg.png</span></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="general-fight-mechanics" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>General Fight Mechanics</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="before-the-fight" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Before The Fight</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ There are 6 weekly rotations that cycle every Wednesday at 00:00 Game Time.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The six rotations are, in order: Ceiling Collapse (Ceiling) → Scopulus (Scop/Scops) → Vitalis (Vit) → Green Bomb (GB) → Teamsplit (TS) → The End (Purple Bomb/PB)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ There are three roles at Vorago.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Base Tank: Takes melee damage, positions Vorago, and handles various mechanics throughout the fight</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Bomb Tank: Often abbreviated &quot;bt&quot;. Tanks magic damage blue bombs and handles various mechanics throughout the fight.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Not to be confused with other &quot;bt&quot; abbreviations, like Yakamaru's base tank</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Top Lure Voke 5: Often abbreviated as TL5/TLV5, or referred to as the &quot;jump/jumper&quot;. Climbs Vorago on phase 1 and handles the 5th bleed during phases 2 and 4.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Entry damage is 70% of your max life points regardless of team size.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This damage also cancels defensive abilities, and the </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="EnhancedExcalibur">[[File:Enhanced Excalibur.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513200949016264727.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>EnhancedExcalibur</nowiki>|<nowiki>EnhancedExcalibur</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> healing effect.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Use </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="disrupt">[[File:Disruption Shield icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>disrupt</nowiki>|<nowiki>disrupt</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="EnhancedExcalibur">[[File:Enhanced Excalibur.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513200949016264727.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>EnhancedExcalibur</nowiki>|<nowiki>EnhancedExcalibur</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> after taking the entry damage</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ There are 12s between challenge and entry damage. Advanced players can use this time to use </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="nat">[[File:Natural Instinct.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>nat</nowiki>|<nowiki>nat</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• There are 36 ticks from challenging Vorago to Target Cycle, and 35 ticks from the Accept Challenge message to Target Cycle.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Drop down damage is 20 ticks after challenging Vorago.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Sample </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="nat">[[File:Natural Instinct.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>nat</nowiki>|<nowiki>nat</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> rotation:</nowiki></p>
<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="display:block;margin:0.9em 0;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-left:4px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:5px;">[https://img.pvme.io/images/JycYCl7.mp4 <nowiki>Watch clip</nowiki>]</span>

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ To time </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="powerburstofvitality">[[File:Powerburst of vitality (4).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>powerburstofvitality</nowiki>|<nowiki>powerburstofvitality</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>, use it 20 ticks after challenging Vorago/accepting challenge.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This can be done by counting each tick from when you challenge by looking at prayer point drain</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It can also be done by looking at the bar above Vorago and clicking on it when it is about to fill, as in the following clip:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MG00fhlSnKA <nowiki>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MG00fhlSnKA</nowiki>]</p>
<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:900px;margin:0.9em 0;"><youtube width=640 height=360>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MG00fhlSnKA</youtube>
<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="font-size:0.85em;">[https://www.youtube.com/embed/MG00fhlSnKA <nowiki>Video source</nowiki>]</span></div>

</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="during-the-fight" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>During The Fight</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Vorago has two basic auto attacks: </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Melee Swipes</nowiki></strong><nowiki> and </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Blue Bombs</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Melee swipes target the base tank. They are AoE 1 square around Vorago, and have additional range around the base tank.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Blue bombs are thrown at the furthest player from Vorago, typically the bomb tank. These are homing, deal high magic damage, don't splash, and have a three tile range (7x7) AoE.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vorago can also do both attacks simultaneously. He will use the animation for a blue bomb.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Because all of Vorago's attacks are AoE, all members of the team must be conscious of their positioning at all times to prevent unnecessary and unintended damage.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Diagram of Vorago's attack radii:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/OF84Vp9.png</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ During phases 1-4, Vorago clears </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Vuln">[[File:Vulnerability icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537349530551582720.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Vuln</nowiki>|<nowiki>Vuln</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>, and regenerates stats almost instantly.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This includes defence drains, such as </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="swh">[[File:Superior Statius's warhammer.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>swh</nowiki>|<nowiki>swh</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="spec">[[File:Weapon Special Attack.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>spec</nowiki>|<nowiki>spec</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Affinity debuffs will last their full one minute duration.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Advanced players can spam </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="vulnbomb">[[File:Vulnerability bomb.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>vulnbomb</nowiki>|<nowiki>vulnbomb</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> to maintain </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Vuln">[[File:Vulnerability icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537349530551582720.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Vuln</nowiki>|<nowiki>Vuln</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> uptime.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Phases 1 and 2 are the same regardless of the weekly rotation.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Vorago's click box spawns in with the boss's animation. As such, Target Cycle can be used to attack Vorago one tick sooner than clicking at the start of every phase.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This can be used to damage Vorago before he uses his first attack, including Teamsplits, Waterfalls, and Purple Bombs.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ In cases where Vorago becomes invulnerable after his first attack, a fast-hitting ability must be used. Slow-hitting abilities will be nulled.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ There is a one tick window between phases during which </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="HealOther">[[File:Heal Other icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727985851891715.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>HealOther</nowiki>|<nowiki>HealOther</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> can be used without taking damage. This can be used to mitigate food usage for the team.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This tick is often referred to as the &quot;crack tick&quot;, as it occurs as the floor is cracking/breaking into the next phase</nowiki></p>
<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="display:block;margin:0.9em 0;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-left:4px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:5px;">[https://img.pvme.io/images/uWBArh4.mp4 <nowiki>Watch clip</nowiki>]</span>

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ There are 17 ticks from the crack tick to the Target Cycle tick.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Target Cycle can be timed by using an ability with a 10s cooldown ability, such as </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="mob">[[File:Mobile.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501908628799488.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>mob</nowiki>|<nowiki>mob</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="surge">[[File:Surge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>surge</nowiki>|<nowiki>surge</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Ensure they are not on cooldown when avoiding Vorago's jumps at the end of each phase.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Three maul pieces are obtained throughout the fight. The three pieces are combined to create the Maul of Omens. This is used at the end of phase 5 to finish Vorago off.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Maul pieces are dropped during phases 1, 2, and 4.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Maul pieces can be left on the floor until the end of phase 4 if inventory space is an issue.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Do </nowiki><em><nowiki>not</nowiki></em><nowiki> drop the maul piece on a crack tick. This causes the maul piece to disappear entirely, failing the kill.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="phase-1" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Phase 1</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="new-special-mechanics" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>New Special Mechanics</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ New special attack: </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Red Bomb</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Thrown at the furthest player away from Vorago.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Deals 2k damage in a 2 tile range (5x5)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Cancels defensive abilities and puts them on a short cooldown.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Damage cannot be blocked or reduced with anything other than </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Damage is increased by 1k for any player standing within a 5 tile radius (11x11) of the target</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Comes with a non homing blue bomb that can be dodged by moving.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Non homing blue has a 3 tile radius (7x7)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Can hit any nearby player, not just the player with the Red Bomb</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="voragos-attack-rotation" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Vorago's Attack Rotation</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:472px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/EOpDHbN.png</span></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="base-tank" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Base Tank</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ There are two ways to lure Vorago on this phase. The beginner method in trio+ teams is to lure Vorago towards the northeast corner so that the TL5 does not receive bombs.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In this lure method, because the Base Tank is expected to move after the TL5 repositions Vorago, </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sunshine">[[File:Sunshine.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sunshine</nowiki>|<nowiki>sunshine</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="deathsswift">[[File:Death's Swiftness.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>deathsswift</nowiki>|<nowiki>deathsswift</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> are less effective. Consider using </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="meta">[[File:Metamorphosis.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533811304497183.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>meta</nowiki>|<nowiki>meta</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> or </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="ecb">[[File:Eldritch crossbow.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>ecb</nowiki>|<nowiki>ecb</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="spec">[[File:Weapon Special Attack.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>spec</nowiki>|<nowiki>spec</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> instead.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/VT5GQZX.png</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The advanced method is to lure Vorago near the northwest corner to give the TL5 bombs. This is typical in trios, and expected in duos. Care must be taken not to lure Vorago too far west so that the TL5 can provoke Vorago into the right position.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• There is a precise </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sunshine">[[File:Sunshine.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sunshine</nowiki>|<nowiki>sunshine</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="deathsswift">[[File:Death's Swiftness.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>deathsswift</nowiki>|<nowiki>deathsswift</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> spot which can be used to line Vorago up with the cliff in case of a bad lure.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Stand at the west edge of the ultimate if Vorago walks east, and vice versa.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Note that in duos, Vorago can throw Blue Bombs at the Base Tank. This chance is increased if Vorago is east of the jump spot.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Sample Advanced Mage/Ranged Lure P1:</nowiki></strong> [https://clips.twitch.tv/CourageousPiercingStarPhilosoraptor <nowiki>https://clips.twitch.tv/CourageousPiercingStarPhilosoraptor</nowiki>]</p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/HORprJx.png</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ In trio+ teams, the Base Tank should use provoke after the TL5 enters the cliff.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If the Bomb Tank is damaging Vorago on the Target Cycle tick, the Base Tank should account for the one tick later entry into the cliff.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ In duos, the Base Tank can use </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="HealOther">[[File:Heal Other icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727985851891715.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>HealOther</nowiki>|<nowiki>HealOther</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> on the Bomb Tank during the jump animation to help the Bomb Tank survive.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The Bomb Tank's click box will remain at the top of the cliff until the end of the animation.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Advanced melee Base Tanks may opt to position Vorago into the proper position for the TL5.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Referred to as &quot;solo lure&quot;</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• See </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span><nowiki> for a detailed explanation</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Not used by mage and ranged Base Tanks due to </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sunshine">[[File:Sunshine.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sunshine</nowiki>|<nowiki>sunshine</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="deathsswift">[[File:Death's Swiftness.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>deathsswift</nowiki>|<nowiki>deathsswift</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> area limitation</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="bomb-tank" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Bomb Tank</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ In trio+ teams, confirm with the Base Tank on which lure will be used.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If tanking bombs, make sure to keep HP high after entry damage</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Position </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sunshine">[[File:Sunshine.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sunshine</nowiki>|<nowiki>sunshine</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="deathsswift">[[File:Death's Swiftness.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>deathsswift</nowiki>|<nowiki>deathsswift</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> accordingly.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The positions are not precise, and have a large margin for error.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/j97kY7v.png</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ In duos, the Bomb Tank is expected to climb while tanking bombs.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The damage taken during climb can be extremely high. This is further exacerbated by the inability to eat during climbing animations.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Try to eat to full HP before starting the climb, and eat accordingly.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ A fast climb is imperative to mitigating damage. See the TL5 section for the expected climbs.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Because the Bomb Tank also tanks bombs during the jump animation, the Bomb Tank should eat to high HP before jumping.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Pray </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="DeflectMage">[[File:Deflect Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>DeflectMage</nowiki>|<nowiki>DeflectMage</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> to block Blue Bombs.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Deflect Prayer can be changed once during the jump animation by clicking on the appropriate Deflect Prayer </nowiki><em><nowiki>from the prayer book</nowiki></em><nowiki>. The Deflect Prayer will change as soon as the player hits the ground, and will block damage accordingly.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ In duos, the Bomb Tank can also apply a </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="swh">[[File:Superior Statius's warhammer.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>swh</nowiki>|<nowiki>swh</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="spec">[[File:Weapon Special Attack.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>spec</nowiki>|<nowiki>spec</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> using the Target Cycle mechanic. This alleviates the Base Tank's rotation.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• An additional </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="bloodbarrage">[[File:Blood Barrage icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>bloodbarrage</nowiki>|<nowiki>bloodbarrage</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="deto">[[File:Detonate.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>deto</nowiki>|<nowiki>deto</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>, or stalled </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="snap">[[File:Snap Shot.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>snap</nowiki>|<nowiki>snap</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> can be used to deal more damage.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Damage dealt during climbing animations is nulled. Make sure to delay entry into the cliff by 1 tick to make sure that the damage lands.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Should the damage be nulled, the affinity debuff from </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="swh">[[File:Superior Statius's warhammer.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>swh</nowiki>|<nowiki>swh</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="spec">[[File:Weapon Special Attack.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>spec</nowiki>|<nowiki>spec</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> will still apply.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="tl5" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>TL5</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Position next to the cliff on the west side of the arena, and spam click to enter.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vorago does not move until someone enters the cliff. Entering the cliff on time is important to ensuring the Base Tank's lure.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Because the TL5 receives a Red Bomb at the start of the fight, </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="disrupt">[[File:Disruption Shield icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>disrupt</nowiki>|<nowiki>disrupt</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> should be used during the climb instead of on entry.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Climbing quickly is an important, but often overlooked skill.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In trio+ teams, the limiting factor in the phase is often how quickly the TL5 can position Vorago.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In duo teams, fast climbs are required to mitigate damage</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ There are three climbs.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="surge">[[File:Surge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>surge</nowiki>|<nowiki>surge</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> → </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="bd">[[File:Bladed Dive.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>bd</nowiki>|<nowiki>bd</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> → </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="surge">[[File:Surge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>surge</nowiki>|<nowiki>surge</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Slowest, but easiest of the three climbs</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="surge">[[File:Surge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>surge</nowiki>|<nowiki>surge</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> → </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="bd">[[File:Bladed Dive.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>bd</nowiki>|<nowiki>bd</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> → </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="surge">[[File:Surge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>surge</nowiki>|<nowiki>surge</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> Climb Demonstration: </nowiki>[https://youtu.be/of6PdOdQBpw <nowiki>https://youtu.be/of6PdOdQBpw</nowiki>]</p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);"><nowiki>‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="surge">[[File:Surge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>surge</nowiki>|<nowiki>surge</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> → </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="surge">[[File:Surge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>surge</nowiki>|<nowiki>surge</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> → </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="bd">[[File:Bladed Dive.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>bd</nowiki>|<nowiki>bd</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> using the corner cut method</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ More difficult than the previous climb due to the precision of the corner cut Bladed Dive, but faster</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="surge">[[File:Surge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>surge</nowiki>|<nowiki>surge</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> → </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="surge">[[File:Surge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>surge</nowiki>|<nowiki>surge</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> → Corner Cut </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="bd">[[File:Bladed Dive.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>bd</nowiki>|<nowiki>bd</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> Climb Demonstration: </nowiki>[https://youtu.be/tXqfyJwBIyk <nowiki>https://youtu.be/tXqfyJwBIyk</nowiki>]</p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);"><nowiki>‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><span (4).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/756236265472524418.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>powerburstofacceleration</nowiki>|<nowiki>powerburstofacceleration</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> is used. </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;"
