<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The Bomb Tank usually </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> the weekly special attack. See each week's section for additional information.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="p4-ceiling-collapse" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>P4: Ceiling Collapse</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="voragos-attack-rotation_7" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Vorago's Attack Rotation</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/KklN0Ua.png</span></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="phase-notes_6" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Phase Notes</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Rocks remaining from phase 3 will fall into phase 4.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The positions of these rocks carry over. Thus, remembering a safe spot from phase 3 is important to avoiding unnecessary damage.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Falling rocks from the phase transition deal 4k damage.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Corner rocks can block waterfalls. Additionally, two adjacent cardinal direction rocks can block a waterfall (e.g. a south and east rock block the southeast waterfall)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Destroying rocks deals 4k damage. Be prepared to eat and destroy rocks at the start of phase 4.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ A waterfall can be blocked by two cardinal direction rocks and a corner rock, so players may have to destroy two rocks to access a waterfall.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ When Vorago starts his Ceiling Collapse special attack, the Bomb Tank should use </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> + </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Cept">[[File:Intercept icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>|<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Every member of the team should aim to destroy any remaining rocks that haven't been cleared while </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> + </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Cept">[[File:Intercept icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>|<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> is active. This includes the imminent rock.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Bleeds occur shortly after Vorago lands from the Ceiling Collapse special attack. The team may still be spread out clearing rocks. Move melee distance ASAP to handle Bleeds and prevent Vorago from stalling his attack rotation.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="clone-skip-notes" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Clone Skip Notes</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The Bomb Tank cannot </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> both Ceiling Collapse rocks. The Base Tank should </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> one of them.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• However, if no form of Turtling is used (e.g., </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> with </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="ancientrepriser">[[File:Ancient repriser.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643150658891153428.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>ancientrepriser</nowiki>|<nowiki>ancientrepriser</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>) then the Bomb Tank can do both </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Take caution if you do not have Malletops </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="malletops">[[File:Malletops.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/690136117374484508.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>malletops</nowiki>|<nowiki>malletops</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> extension as it may mean your </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> would be shorter than Intercept </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Cept">[[File:Intercept icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>|<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Rocks from phase 3 that are east, south, or west must be cleared before the first Waterfall.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vorago will never walk north.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="p4-scopulus" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>P4: Scopulus</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="voragos-attack-rotation_8" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Vorago's Attack Rotation</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/hVrOm2k.png</span></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="phase-notes_7" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Phase Notes</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Scopulus does not have a weekly special attack for phases 4 and 5. For phase 4, a Red Bomb takes the place where the weekly special attack would occur.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Handle the Red Bomb in the same manner as phase 2. Either the Base Tank or the Bomb Tank can </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The Bomb Tank can surge from max attack range to move underneath Vorago to force the Red Bomb.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="clone-skip-notes_1" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Clone Skip Notes</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The Bomb Tank cannot </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> both Red Bombs. The Base Tank should </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> one of them.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• However, if no form of Turtling is used (e.g., </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> with </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="ancientrepriser">[[File:Ancient repriser.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643150658891153428.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>ancientrepriser</nowiki>|<nowiki>ancientrepriser</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>) then the Bomb Tank can do both </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Take caution if you do not have Malletops </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="malletops">[[File:Malletops.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/690136117374484508.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>malletops</nowiki>|<nowiki>malletops</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> extension as it may mean your </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> would be shorter than Intercept </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Cept">[[File:Intercept icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>|<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="p4-vitalis" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>P4: Vitalis</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="voragos-attack-rotation_9" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Vorago's Attack Rotation</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/fbsKV1l.png</span></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="phase-notes_8" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Phase Notes</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Vitalis Orbs will always be north, east, or northeast if not doing Clone Skip, assuming Vorago does not move from the centre of the arena.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The team should move to the northeast during the 7 auto attacks after the Stone Clone to prepare for the Vitalis Orb.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Killing the Vitali that spawn is top priority, as they cause a number of pathing problems.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dommine">[[File:Dominion mine.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dommine</nowiki>|<nowiki>dommine</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> can be used to help with Vitali, though they only deal 4k damage each.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="clone-skip-notes_2" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Clone Skip Notes</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The Bomb Tank cannot </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> both Vitalis Orbs. The Base Tank should </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> one of them.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• However, if no form of Turtling is used (e.g., </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> with </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="ancientrepriser">[[File:Ancient repriser.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643150658891153428.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>ancientrepriser</nowiki>|<nowiki>ancientrepriser</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>) then the Bomb Tank can do both </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Take caution if you do not have Malletops </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="malletops">[[File:Malletops.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/690136117374484508.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>malletops</nowiki>|<nowiki>malletops</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> extension as it may mean your </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> would be shorter than Intercept </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Cept">[[File:Intercept icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>|<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Due to the alternating </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>, ample DPS on both Vorago and Vitali are required from both the Base and Bomb Tanks.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Because Vorago moves from the centre of the room, the direction of the Vitalis orbs are random.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="p4-green-bomb" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>P4: Green Bomb</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="voragos-attack-rotation_10" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Vorago's Attack Rotation</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/P7qduyh.png</span></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="phase-notes_9" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Phase Notes</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The Green Bomb principles from phase 3 apply to phase 4.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tanking the Green Bomb instead of passing it is preferable.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• While there are normally five auto attacks after a Green Bomb, tanking the Green Bomb shortens this to three auto attacks.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Passing before tanking the Green Bomb leads to a longer phase, and can have undesirable effects.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Since this is a time gated phase, use </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> + </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Cept">[[File:Intercept icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>|<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> to block the 10k damage from the Green Bomb.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If the Green Bomb is NOT on the Bomb Tank: the Bomb Tank should </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> + </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Cept">[[File:Intercept icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>|<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> the team.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If the Green Bomb IS on the Bomb Tank: the Base Tank should </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> + </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Cept">[[File:Intercept icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>|<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> the team.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="clone-skip-notes_3" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Clone Skip Notes</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Neither the Base Tank nor the Bomb Tank can </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> both Green Bombs assuming the use of Turtling 4.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The Base Tank should be prepared to tank a 10k with </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and/or </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="powerburstofvitality">[[File:Powerburst of vitality (4).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>powerburstofvitality</nowiki>|<nowiki>powerburstofvitality</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> if either role receives both Green Bombs.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• However, if no form of Turtling is used (e.g., </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> with </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="ancientrepriser">[[File:Ancient repriser.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643150658891153428.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>ancientrepriser</nowiki>|<nowiki>ancientrepriser</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>) then the a player can </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> both if needed.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Take caution if you do not have Malletops </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="malletops">[[File:Malletops.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/690136117374484508.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>malletops</nowiki>|<nowiki>malletops</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> extension as it may mean your </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> would be shorter than Intercept </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Cept">[[File:Intercept icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>|<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="p4-teamsplit" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>P4: Teamsplit</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="voragos-attack-rotation_11" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Vorago's Attack Rotation</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/qj6rlQa.png</span></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="phase-notes_10" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Phase Notes</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> after Teamsplit if the additional damage reduction + Heal Other are required. Otherwise, this can be skipped.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Like phase 3, Teamsplits can be broken during this phase.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Unlike phase 3, Broken Teamsplits are beneficial during this phase because they alleviate some of the time gate.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Bleed a melee ability using the </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="gbarge">[[File:Greater Barge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>gbarge</nowiki>|<nowiki>gbarge</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> effect just before the Teamsplit.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Any melee ability affected by </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="gbarge">[[File:Greater Barge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>gbarge</nowiki>|<nowiki>gbarge</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> works.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Splashing does not matter, so anyone can break Teamsplits regardless of primary combat style.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The optimal timing is to </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="gbarge">[[File:Greater Barge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>gbarge</nowiki>|<nowiki>gbarge</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> one tick after the 6th Blue Bomb, then bleeding an ability immediately after.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Make sure the team is aware of this strategy's use, as it can kill unsuspecting players.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Vorago will throw Blue Bombs during Teamsplit with no animation. In addition, if Vorago is standing next to a player, he can also melee swipe.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="clone-skip-notes_4" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Clone Skip Notes</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Since </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> is optional this week, </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> cooldown does not play a large factor during this week.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ If Clone Skip is paired with Broken Teamsplits, the amount of time the team has to DPS is much shorter than normal. Make sure the team has enough DPS to clear the phase on time.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);"><nowiki>⬥ The optimal timing for Broken Teamsplit with Clone Skip is </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="mob">[[File:Mobile.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501908628799488.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>mob</nowiki>|<nowiki>mob</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="gbarge">[[File:Greater Barge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>gbarge</nowiki>|<nowiki>gbarge</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> → </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="gbarge">[[File:Greater Barge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>gbarge</nowiki>|<nowiki>gbarge</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> immediately off cooldown → wait 1 tick → </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="gflurry">[[File:Greater Flurry.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>gflurry</nowiki>|<nowiki>gflurry</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="p4-the-end" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>P4: The End</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="voragos-attack-rotation_12" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Vorago's Attack Rotation</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/REPpAAF.png</span></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="phase-notes_11" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Phase Notes</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Because this phase is time gated, defensive abilities can be used to mitigate most or all of the damage during this phase.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The Base Tank should tag all of the Red Bombs during this phase, while the Bomb Tank should use </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> + </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Cept">[[File:Intercept icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>|<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> + Heal Other on the team.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ On Vorago's stand, the Base Tank should use </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> + </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Cept">[[File:Intercept icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>|<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> on the team.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ When Vorago throws his Red Bomb, the Base Tank should do one of the following:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Cept">[[File:Intercept icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>|<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> the Bomb Tank again using the remaining </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> duration (Malletops + T90 Shield </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> + Turtling 3 only)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> + </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Cept">[[File:Intercept icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>|<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> the Bomb Tank.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Move melee distance and use </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="voke">[[File:Provoke.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>voke</nowiki>|<nowiki>voke</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> to reduce the number of Blue Bombs the Bomb Tank receives.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ If the Base Tank and Bomb Tank reverse their </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> order, the Bomb Tank's </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> may be on cooldown at the start of phase 5.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="clone-skip-notes_5" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Clone Skip Notes</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Due to phase length, Clone Skip is largely unaffected by </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> timing. The </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> strategy without Clone Skip still applies.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Turtling 4 prevents players from using </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> on time. Turtling 3 is recommended.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="transition-into-phase-5" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Transition into Phase 5</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="end-of-p4" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>End of P4</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Vorago's HP should be lowered before the third Waterfall. Ideally, </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="shatter">[[File:Shatter.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256673904328704.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>shatter</nowiki>|<nowiki>shatter</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> should finish Vorago off.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• A </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="vulnbomb">[[File:Vulnerability bomb.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>vulnbomb</nowiki>|<nowiki>vulnbomb</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> can be thrown to aid this.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="swh">[[File:Superior Statius's warhammer.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>swh</nowiki>|<nowiki>swh</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="spec">[[File:Weapon Special Attack.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>spec</nowiki>|<nowiki>spec</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> can be used some time before the last Waterfall to aid with hit chance.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Rangers should use bolts other than </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="RubyBakri">[[File:Ruby bakriminel bolts (e) 5.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489413287956.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>RubyBakri</nowiki>|<nowiki>RubyBakri</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> for </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="shatter">[[File:Shatter.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256673904328704.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>shatter</nowiki>|<nowiki>shatter</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>. Reequip </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="RubyBakri">[[File:Ruby bakriminel bolts (e) 5.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489413287956.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>RubyBakri</nowiki>|<nowiki>RubyBakri</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> before the start of phase 5.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The mauler should pick up the first two maul pieces </nowiki><em><nowiki>before</nowiki></em><nowiki> the third waterfall.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The default maul player, unless otherwise specified, is: any melee player → TL5 (trio+) → Bomb Tank (duo)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Like the transition from phase 2 to phase 3, </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="nat">[[File:Natural Instinct.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>nat</nowiki>|<nowiki>nat</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> can be used to build additional adrenaline from a dummy.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The ideal dummy position is close to the center of the arena.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="nat">[[File:Natural Instinct.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>nat</nowiki>|<nowiki>nat</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> timing is largely the same as the phase 2 → phase 3 transition</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Facing direction is preserved between phases. The Bomb Tank can start a </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="nat">[[File:Natural Instinct.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>nat</nowiki>|<nowiki>nat</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> rotation facing east, and </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="surge">[[File:Surge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>surge</nowiki>|<nowiki>surge</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> during global cooldown on phase 5 to place a melee distance </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="deathsswift">[[File:Death's Swiftness.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>deathsswift</nowiki>|<nowiki>deathsswift</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Avoid using </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="surge">[[File:Surge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>surge</nowiki>|<nowiki>surge</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> on t-15, as it causes some strange loading issues.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The third maul piece spawns on the floor near Vorago after the third Waterfall. A red dot on the minimap can be used to help find the maul piece.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="phase-5" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Phase 5</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="new-special-mechanics_9" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>New Special Mechanics</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>New special arena: </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Pushing Vorago</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Vorago spawns in the middle of a long and narrow phase 5 arena.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Vorago covers the width of the arena and is blocking, preventing access to the eastern side of Vorago.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sgb">[[File:Seren godbow.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sgb</nowiki>|<nowiki>sgb</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="spec">[[File:Weapon Special Attack.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>spec</nowiki>|<nowiki>spec</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> hits Vorago as if he were a blocking entity.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Players must push Vorago eight tiles east from his starting position, then use the Maul of Omens.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Players can push Vorago one tile east by dealing about 20k damage.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Commonly referred to as &quot;push&quot;.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The damage threshold is more complex than this. For a detailed explanation, see </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Vorago will push players backward by dealing damage to the team.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Commonly referred to as &quot;push back&quot;.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Push back is not relative to the amount of damage players receive.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Each attack has its own value push back value.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Melee Swipes and Blue Bombs push back the team.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In duos and trios, this number is always one tile of push back for every successful hit.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In teams of 4+, this may not always hold true.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Melee swipes only occur if at least one player is standing within melee distance.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Because Vorago can use both his melee swipe and Blue Bomb in a single auto attack, players may receive two squares of push back in a single auto attack.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• AoE damage can affect push back.*</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Only a limited number of defensive options can prevent push back from auto attacks.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> (Blocks all push back from auto attacks during its duration)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="disrupt">[[File:Disruption Shield icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>disrupt</nowiki>|<nowiki>disrupt</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> (Blocks all push back from a single auto attack)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sd">[[File:Shield Dome icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537341954392850442.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sd</nowiki>|<nowiki>sd</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> (Blocks half a tile of push back per auto attack while </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sd">[[File:Shield Dome icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537341954392850442.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sd</nowiki>|<nowiki>sd</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> is active. Only occurs at 50% damage reduction. Recommended only during Reflect.)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="debil">[[File:Debilitate.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>debil</nowiki>|<nowiki>debil</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> (Blocks half a tile of push back per auto attack while </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="debil">[[File:Debilitate.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>debil</nowiki>|<nowiki>debil</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> is active. Not recommended.)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• All other defensive options (</nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="res">[[File:Resonance.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>res</nowiki>|<nowiki>res</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="reflect">[[File:Reflect.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>|<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> etc) do not affect push back.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Some of Vorago's special attacks push back the team.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Damage from PKing on Reflect will cause push back. The amount of push back varies on the ability and damage dealt.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tanking melee bleed ticks from Vorago's Smash will cause push back. The amount of push back per tick of damage is 1/team size (e.g. duos is 1/2 tile per tick of damage)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• See the weekly rotation sections below for other sources of push back.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Only one tile of push and push back per tick can occur.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Push and push back can occur on the same tick.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Because only one tile of push back can occur, an auto attack hitting multiple players will still only push back one tile.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• An auto attack that hits multiple players can only be blocked if </nowiki><em><nowiki>all</nowiki></em><nowiki> players are under the effects of </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>. If even one person receives damage, the auto attack will cause push back.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Vorago will slightly raise his defence level for each tile Vorago is pushed east past the starting point.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/b5itISX.png</span></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="general-phase-notes_4" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>General Phase Notes</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The Maul of Omens can be created by clicking any of the maul pieces while all three are in the mauler's inventory.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Once Vorago is at the eastern edge of the arena, use the Maul of Omens within halberd range by clicking on the maul.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ After the first auto attack, Vorago's attack speed changes to once every three ticks.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vorago no longer clears </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Vuln">[[File:Vulnerability icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537349530551582720.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Vuln</nowiki>|<nowiki>Vuln</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="smokecloud">[[File:Smoke Cloud icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>smokecloud</nowiki>|<nowiki>smokecloud</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> after this point.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Vorago cannot attack on the same tick he is pushed.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The next Blue Bomb will be at least 3 ticks after he is pushed.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Players can stall Vorago's attack rotation indefinitely by pushing Vorago at least once every three ticks.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ This is commonly known as &quot;stall&quot; and &quot;stalling&quot;.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ With a strong, well-timed rotation, teams can completely prevent Vorago from attacking.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Finishing this phase before Reflect, or even the first special attack is possible. These are known as 0 link and 0 spec phases respectively.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ These strategies employ more aggressive rotations, which usually include the Bomb Tank skipping </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> for a damage boosting ultimate. However, these strategies can be slower if the phase does not finish before Reflect.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ List of stall durations:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vorago is pushed: 3 ticks</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vorago pushes back (any source): 6 ticks</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vorago uses a special attack:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Purple Bomb: 5 ticks</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Green Bomb: 10 ticks</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Teamsplit: 4 ticks</nowiki></p>
