<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Vitalis: 4 ticks</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Stall duration is overwritten by the most recent cause of stall.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• e.g. If Vorago throws a Green Bomb on tick 1, and Vorago is pushed on tick 2, Vorago will throw a blue bomb on tick 5. The push stall duration overwrites the Green Bomb stall duration.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Because the arena is narrow, players must be careful about preventing AoE damage from Blue Bombs.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The Bomb Tank should be on the northern edge of the arena, while the rest of the team should be on the southern edge. This prevents Blue Bombs from dealing AoE damage.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ While </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="debil">[[File:Debilitate.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>debil</nowiki>|<nowiki>debil</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> can mitigate some push back, players are highly recommended avoiding it. See </nowiki>[https://pvme.io/pvme-guides/rs3-full-boss-guides/vorago/tips-and-tricks/#skipping-debilitate-on-p5 <nowiki>this page</nowiki>]<nowiki> for a detailed explanation.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Vorago's aggro is random and cannot be controlled.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="voke">[[File:Provoke.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>voke</nowiki>|<nowiki>voke</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> cannot be activated on Vorago during this phase.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Vorago's Smash attack is only three smashes long, rather than five.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Because aggro is random, all players must be ready to clear Bleeds.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Distance Bleed clears on this phase are determined by distance from where the player received the bleed, not distance from Vorago.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Using </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="barge">[[File:Barge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532853916860437.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>barge</nowiki>|<nowiki>barge</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> or </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="surge">[[File:Surge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>surge</nowiki>|<nowiki>surge</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> towards Vorago from the far west is an option for Bleed clears.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ If a Bleed is received in an undesirable spot (roughly half way between Vorago and the west side of the arena), there may not be enough distance in either direction to clear the bleed. If this happens, use </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="DeflectMelee">[[File:Deflect Melee.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>DeflectMelee</nowiki>|<nowiki>DeflectMelee</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>, tank the entire Bleed duration, and DPS as much as possible.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dual crossbow range </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="escape">[[File:Escape.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>escape</nowiki>|<nowiki>escape</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> is occasionally not enough to clear Bleeds.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Players should </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="escape">[[File:Escape.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>escape</nowiki>|<nowiki>escape</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> with a 2-handed ranged weapon, or </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="surge">[[File:Surge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>surge</nowiki>|<nowiki>surge</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="bd">[[File:Bladed Dive.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>bd</nowiki>|<nowiki>bd</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> instead.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ There are three ways to clear a triple Bleed.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Standard Method: </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="freedom">[[File:Freedom.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>freedom</nowiki>|<nowiki>freedom</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> → </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="escape">[[File:Escape.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>escape</nowiki>|<nowiki>escape</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> → </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="barge">[[File:Barge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532853916860437.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>barge</nowiki>|<nowiki>barge</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Easier to execute</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Spends two abilities that deal little damage (</nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="freedom">[[File:Freedom.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>freedom</nowiki>|<nowiki>freedom</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>, </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="barge">[[File:Barge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532853916860437.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>barge</nowiki>|<nowiki>barge</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Advanced Method: </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="bd">[[File:Bladed Dive.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>bd</nowiki>|<nowiki>bd</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> → </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="surge">[[File:Surge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>surge</nowiki>|<nowiki>surge</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> → </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="freedom">[[File:Freedom.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>freedom</nowiki>|<nowiki>freedom</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Difficult to execute losslessly</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Spends only one ability that deals little damage (</nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="freedom">[[File:Freedom.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>freedom</nowiki>|<nowiki>freedom</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>), and only if a player receives all three Bleeds.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Mages will need to turn their run off after </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="bd">[[File:Bladed Dive.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>bd</nowiki>|<nowiki>bd</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> to ensure enough distance to </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="surge">[[File:Surge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>surge</nowiki>|<nowiki>surge</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Rangers will need to camp a 2H weapon to ensure enough distance to </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="surge">[[File:Surge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>surge</nowiki>|<nowiki>surge</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Alternative Advanced Method: </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="escape">[[File:Escape.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>escape</nowiki>|<nowiki>escape</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> + </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="bd">[[File:Bladed Dive.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>bd</nowiki>|<nowiki>bd</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> → </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="escape">[[File:Escape.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>escape</nowiki>|<nowiki>escape</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> → </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="freedom">[[File:Freedom.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>freedom</nowiki>|<nowiki>freedom</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Difficult to execute losslessly</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Helps meleers stay melee distance during Bleed clears</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The primary </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> timing is when the first Blue Bomb lands, after Vorago's weekly special attacks.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This can be delayed to the second Blue Bomb if using </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="disrupt">[[File:Disruption Shield icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>disrupt</nowiki>|<nowiki>disrupt</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ If the team expects more than one weekly special attack, the Bomb Tank and Base Tank swap positions immediately after Vorago's third Bleed.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The time between weekly special attacks is too short for one player to </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> two consecutive weekly special attacks.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ There is an earlier Base Tank </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> timing, after Smash but before Vorago's weekly special attack.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Commonly referred to as &quot;early cade&quot;</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Used if the team can finish the phase before or on the weekly special attack release.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="p5-ceiling-collapseteamsplit" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>P5: Ceiling Collapse/Teamsplit</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="voragos-attack-rotation_13" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Vorago's Attack Rotation</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/g3Cgab3.png</span></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="phase-notes_12" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Phase Notes</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Ceiling Collapse does not have its own unique phase 5 mechanic, and instead uses the Teamsplit phase 5 mechanic.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Tanking the 8k damage from Teamsplit does not cause push back, and can be used as a reliable source of </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Reprisal">[[File:Reprisal.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462694912.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Reprisal</nowiki>|<nowiki>Reprisal</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> damage.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Because Teamsplits cancel defensive abilities and put them on cooldown, the last Blue Bomb before Teamsplit usually cannot be blocked.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Unaware players may try to </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="res">[[File:Resonance.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>res</nowiki>|<nowiki>res</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> this Blue Bomb at low HP without Deflect Magic, potentially receiving fatal damage.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Early </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> is not used on this rotation.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="p5-scopulusthe-end" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>P5: Scopulus/The End</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="voragos-attack-rotation_14" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Vorago's Attack Rotation</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/gg1VugJ.png</span></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="phase-notes_13" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Phase Notes</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Scopulus does not have its own unique phase 5 mechanic, and instead uses the &quot;The End&quot; phase 5 mechanic.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Purple Bombs do not cause push back if they only hit their designated targets.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Each Purple Bomb causes one tile of push back if they deal AoE damage.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Purple Bomb timers are counted in ticks, not seconds.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Purple Bomb timers are always at least 5 ticks apart. Two Purple Bombs will never explode at the same time.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ In duos, the Purple Bomb can largely be ignored since players are already separated from each other.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ In trios, the Base Tank does not stand near south edge like usual. The Base Tank instead stands near the north edge, and close to Vorago.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Since the Bomb Tank is also north, the Base Tank and Bomb Tank should watch their distance from each other.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Trio positioning:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/HBbgO5g.png</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ In teams of 4+, all members except the Bomb Tank stand on the south wall. Each player should run north when the timer reaches 5 ticks, wait for the Purple Bomb to explode, then run back south.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The number of Purple Bombs is capped, so not every person may receive one in large teams.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="p5-vitalis" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>P5: Vitalis</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="voragos-attack-rotation_15" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Vorago's Attack Rotation</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/46qliKG.png</span></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="phase-notes_14" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Phase Notes</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Vitalis Orbs always cause push back if at least one player is standing in the Vitalis Orb explosion.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Vitalis Orbs do not cause push back if no one is standing in the Vitalis Orb explosion.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ During this phase, Vitalis Orbs spawn 2-4 Vitali instead of 5.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Vitali melee attacks cause push back. The amount of push back per Vitali melee attack is 1/team size.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Players will inexplicably change targets to Vorago when targeting Vitali. This can be especially detrimental during Reflect.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dommine">[[File:Dominion mine.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dommine</nowiki>|<nowiki>dommine</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> can be preplaced to help deal with Vitali.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dommine">[[File:Dominion mine.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dommine</nowiki>|<nowiki>dommine</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> are mutually exclusive with most </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="nat">[[File:Natural Instinct.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>nat</nowiki>|<nowiki>nat</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> rotations because </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dummy">[[File:Combat dummy MKII.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dummy</nowiki>|<nowiki>dummy</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> count as valid targets.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ This phase can be extremely difficult in duos. Teams without sufficient DPS will struggle to generate enough push to counteract the guaranteed Vitalis Orb push back, and the push back from Vitali.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="p5-green-bomb" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>P5: Green Bomb</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="voragos-attack-rotation_16" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Vorago's Attack Rotation</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/GXSm3mQ.png</span></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="phase-notes_15" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Phase Notes</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The 10k hit from tanking Green Bombs without passing causes push back.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The 1k AoE damage from passing Green Bombs causes push back.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Passing a Green Bomb without dealing AoE damage does not cause push back.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Because tanking Green Bombs forces Vorago into Reflect, and Vorago's attacks can be stalled for an indeterminate amount of time, the number of Blue Bombs between the Green Bomb launch and reflect can be anywhere from 0 to 5.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Because this is the only week during which Blue Bombs can be skipped with more DPS, </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="nat">[[File:Natural Instinct.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>nat</nowiki>|<nowiki>nat</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> is highly recommended.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ As with previous phases, the preferred method of handling the Green Bomb is to tank the 10k damage with a </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="powerburstofvitality">[[File:Powerburst of vitality (4).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>powerburstofvitality</nowiki>|<nowiki>powerburstofvitality</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In duos, players should already be on opposite sides of the arena.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In trios, the TL5 should be on the south edge, while the Bomb Tank and Base Tank should be on the north edge.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ The Base and Bomb Tanks should take extra care not to pass the Green Bomb between each other, as they are both on the north edge of the arena.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Trio positioning:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/HBbgO5g.png</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In teams of 4+, everyone but the Bomb Tank should stand on the south edge. The player with the Green Bomb should run to the north edge, tank the 10k hit, and run back south.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ While the Green Bomb is normally followed by a long delay in Vorago's attacks, this only happens for the first Green Bomb. Subsequent Green Bombs will be followed by Blue Bombs in quick succession.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The Bomb Tank must be at a higher HP than usual to tank subsequent Green Bombs with a </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="powerburstofvitality">[[File:Powerburst of vitality (4).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>powerburstofvitality</nowiki>|<nowiki>powerburstofvitality</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• A Bomb Tank cannot survive subsequent Green Bombs on his own without a </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="powerburstofvitality">[[File:Powerburst of vitality (4).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>powerburstofvitality</nowiki>|<nowiki>powerburstofvitality</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Should the phase last this long, the onus lies on the Base Tank to save the Bomb Tank.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ The preferred method to deal with this situation is </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> + </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Cept">[[File:Intercept icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>|<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>For those interested in reading up on more Vorago-related information and theorycrafting, take a look at Rago Hub and their wealth of knowledge: </nowiki>[https://discord.gg/uqGJbKH <nowiki>https://discord.gg/uqGJbKH</nowiki>]</p>
